config.purpose: Bounded point-level check of information lost by object/class pooling; not a new trained architecture
config.selection: All eight independent_dev_added logs, all 321 cached keyframes; no new test access
config.inputs: Previously cached raw PTv3 labels, raw XYZ and supplied ego poses only
config.history: Exactly the preceding raw scan, at most 0.75 seconds old; no corrected-label feedback
config.operator: Current point plus up to four neighboring raw labels, plurality vote; ties keep current label when possible, otherwise choose the lowest label. Current-spatial excludes the query point itself.
config.observer_only: After predictions, count current errors with a correct same-class/same-instance historical neighbor, and whether the matched current neighborhood already contains a correct answer. GT never gates the actual vote.
config.failure_action: Do not tune radius, neighbor count, train a point-memory network or open holdout on this evidence. Preserve the negative comparison.
config.scope: Development diagnosis with fixed cached backbone outputs; raw 2Hz scans and supplied poses, not live estimated-motion or latency proof
